title: Network partition between app servers and database
symptoms: Complete loss of database connectivity from app servers. Errors: psycopg2.OperationalError: could not connect to server: Connection timed out. Error rate 100%. Database server reachable from monitoring but not from app nodes. netstat showing no established DB connections.
root_cause: A misconfigured firewall rule update deployed by the infrastructure team blocked port 5432 between the app subnet (10.0.1.0/24) and the database subnet (10.0.2.0/24). The firewall change was applied during a routine security hardening exercise without testing database connectivity.
fix_applied: 1. Identified partition via: ping 10.0.2.5 from app server (OK) vs telnet 10.0.2.5 5432 (FAIL). 2. Infrastructure team reverted firewall rule via terraform apply. 3. Applications auto-reconnected within 30 seconds. 4. Added automated connectivity checks to deployment pipeline. 5. Created pre/post change validation checklist.
